sentences.text: William Henry Pratt -LRB- 23 November 1887 -- 2 February 1969 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Boris Karloff , was an English actor who was primarily known for his typecast roles in horror films that depicted the characters Frankenstein and The Mummy .	stage name	stage name	Frankenstein	Frankenstein (1931 film)	The Mummy	The Mummy (1932 film)

He portrayed Frankenstein 's monster in Frankenstein -LRB- 1931 -RRB- , Bride of Frankenstein -LRB- 1935 -RRB- , and Son of Frankenstein -LRB- 1939 -RRB- , which resulted in his immense popularity .	Frankenstein	Frankenstein (1931 film)	Bride of Frankenstein	Bride of Frankenstein	Son of Frankenstein	Son of Frankenstein
He also appeared as Imhotep in The Mummy -LRB- 1932 -RRB- .	Imhotep	Imhotep (The Mummy)	The Mummy	The Mummy (1932 film)
His best-known non-horror role is as the Grinch , as well as the narrator , in the animated television special of Dr. Seuss 's How the Grinch Stole Christmas !	Grinch	Grinch	Dr. Seuss	Dr. Seuss
Karloff guest starred in a 1966 TV episode of The Wild Wild West , `` The Night of the Golden Cobra '' .	The Wild Wild West	The Wild Wild West
He also had a memorable role in the original Scarface -LRB- 1932 -RRB- .	Scarface	Scarface (1932 film)
